announced on Wednesday that it will consolidate its shares 1-for-10, effective at market open on October 14, 2026.
The shares outstanding will fall from about 193.6M to 19.4M.
The company will also change its name to Cruz Mining, while keeping the CRUZ trading symbol.
The warrants will be proportionally adjusted, with fractional shares below 0.5 canceled and those of 0.5 or more rounded up.
Nancy Chow was appointed CFO, replacing Cindy Cai.

title: Cruz Battery Metals sets 1-for-10 reverse stock split; CFO change
